annotations.text: 1 · JACKPOT POP — sunny yellow ground, cherry red and teal, marquee bulbs and confetti. The loudest and most celebratory; least calm for a long score table.
2 · CANDY CHIPS — cream ground, glossy poker chips as the tile system, soft shadows. Friendliest; can read closer to a game app than a casino.
3 · SLOT MACHINE — fairground red, white and royal blue, tiles as reel windows, hard offset shadows. Clearest casino read; busiest ground.
4 · RETRO VEGAS — 60s motel signage: cream, burnt orange, turquoise, cherry, arched tiles and starbursts. Most distinctive; retro can date faster.
5 · TROPICAL TABLE — turquoise felt, coral and sunshine yellow, rounded and breezy. Colourful without shouting; least obviously a casino.
6 · NEON ARCADE — deep indigo with hot pink, cyan and lime neon. The trending online-casino look, and the only dark one of the six.
